svg.aria-label: run_all_blocks and run_one_block, line by line, matching the expanded step 3 picture. The list starts with the state before block 1, size 0.50: the top box. The loop runs four times, one for each block box, each block with its own trained numbers. Each block starts from the latest result in the list, the arrow into each block. run_one_block is one block box, and its result is added to the list as entries 1 to 4. Inside run_one_block, attention works out a vector of size 0.59 in block 1, the orange attention box; the first plus adds it without replacing anything; the MLP works out a vector of size 1.66, the orange MLP box; and the second plus gives the blue box, size 2.16 after block 1.
